Dear Lean community,

I’m hiring those of you who are natural supervisors with math/Lean/AI experience to become research managers at Talmenta, my early-stage startup to orchestrate the worldwide roll-out of AI-assisted mathematical research.

Lean is central to what we are building: it provides a natural bridge between mathematical knowledge and AI systems, allowing formalized mathematics to become part of the computational environment in which AI-assisted research happens. All Talmenta research projects are Lean-based, and we are specifically looking for people from the Lean community to help make these projects work.

As a research manager, you would supervise ~10–30 mathematicians and AI researchers across several Lean-based projects for professors worldwide. Your existing Lean experience would therefore be highly useful, although you do not need to be a Lean expert. Professors provide the relevant mathematical expertise, while your primary role is to coordinate researchers and develop people. Full job description. Apply at jasper.kreeke@talmenta.org!

Best wishes
Jasper van de Kreeke
